chunks: Yūnus narrated from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I asked Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام about taʿzīr: how much is it? He said: “A number of ten lashes, between ten and twenty.”

key_terms.أَبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Abā Ibrāhīm, the Imam عليه السلام being asked
key_terms.التَّعْزِيرِ: discretionary punishment imposed for an offense not carrying a fixed hadd
key_terms.الْعَشَرَةِ: ten, the lower end of the stated range
key_terms.الْعِشْرِينَ: twenty, the upper end of the stated range
key_terms.سَوْطًا: lashes, meaning strikes with a whip

ai.seo_question: What is the number of lashes for taʿzīr according to Imam Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding taʿzīr, a discretionary punishment. Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام states that it is a number of lashes falling between ten and twenty, indicating a defined but non-fixed penal range within jurisprudence.
